name: Asahina Yuuya
source:
The protagonist. A student.

He returned to the town he grew up in to attend a school there. He lives alone in an apartment. He spends exciting days with the two childhood friends who used to dote on him. He likes older women with big breasts, and is weak to sexual temptation.
